cohort: The study included 1352 women in Switzerland who had given birth in the last five years.
finding: An increased frequency of experienced weight stigma during childbirth was related to higher odds of intrapartum cesarean birth and partially mediated the relationship between increased pre-pregnancy BMI and CB.
mod_finding: An increased frequency of experienced weight stigma during childbirth was associated with higher odds of cesarean birth.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from women regarding their childbirth experiences in the last five years.
